title: Degranulation and Cytokine Production Functional Assay
author: Philippa R Kennedy

Data is analyzed using FlowJo software (Tree Star Inc., RRID:SCR_008520) Degranulation (CD107a+) and cytokine production (IFNγ+ or TNFα+) are assessed for the live (dead cell marker-) NK cell (CD56+ CD3-) population.

One hour after the addition of anti-CD107a, cells are given monensin (GolgiStop Cat. No. 554724, BD Biosciences) and brefeldin A (GolgiPlug Cat. No. 555029, BD Biosciences). GolgiStop (1/150) and GolgiPlug (1/100) are diluted in R10 and 20 μL is added to each well. Cells are incubated for a further 4 h at 37°C 5% CO 2 . 04:00:00

steps.title: Resuspend effector cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend PBMCs or enriched NK cells in R10 medium; resuspend iPSC‑derived NK cells in B0 medium.

steps.title: Optional Fc‑block for tissue samples
steps.instruction: If working with processed tissues, prepare 5 µL Fc Receptor Blocking Solution (cat. 422302, BioLegend) in 100 µL flow buffer (1 % AB serum, 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS). Resuspend each well in 20 µL of this blocking solution and incubate 5 min at room temperature in the dark. Proceed to surface staining without washing.

steps.title: Plate cells and add targets
steps.instruction: Add 5 × 10⁵ total cells per well to a U‑bottom 96‑well plate (or as few as 1 × 10⁵ effector cells/well if limited, adjusting target numbers accordingly). Add target cells to achieve an effector:target ratio of 2:1.

steps.title: Add anti‑CD107a and incubate
steps.instruction: Add FITC‑conjugated anti‑CD107a (clone H4A3, BioLegend; normally 3 µL per well) to each well. Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash cells twice with flow buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice using flow buffer (1 % AB serum, 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS) as follows:

substeps.instruction: Spin plate at 300 g for 5 min (≈1200 rpm). Remove supernatant and add 200 µL flow buffer to each well (first wash).
Spin again at 300 g for 5 min. Remove supernatant and add 200 µL flow buffer to each well (second wash).

steps.title: Final wash and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the plate a third time at 300 g for 5 min and discard the supernatant (no replacement buffer).

steps.title: Fix cells with paraformaldehyde
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 100 µL 2 % paraformaldehyde/PBS. Incubate 10 min at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Post‑fix wash and optional overnight pause
steps.instruction: Top up each well to 200 µL with flow buffer and wash once with flow buffer. Cells can be paused here overnight:

substeps.instruction: If pausing, wash once more with flow buffer, top up to 100 µL per well, seal plate edges with parafilm, and store at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Permeabilize and intracellular cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 50 µL permeabilization buffer (10 % Permeabilization Buffer, cat. 00‑8333‑56, eBioscience, diluted in distilled H₂O) containing:

substeps.instruction: BV650‑conjugated IFNγ (clone 4S.B3, BioLegend; normally 3 µL per test).
BV421‑conjugated TNFα (clone Mab11, BioLegend; normally 5 µL per test).

steps.title: Incubate intracellular stain
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Post‑stain wash and resuspend
steps.instruction: Top up each well to 200 µL with flow buffer and wash once with flow buffer. Resuspend cells in 200 µL flow buffer and transfer the suspension to 1.5 mL bullet tubes.

steps.title: Store tubes until acquisition
steps.instruction: Cover tubes, store them in the dark at 4 °C until flow cytometry. Run the LSR II (BD Biosciences) at a consistent speed (e.g., high) and acquire data for a fixed time (e.g., 60 s).

steps.title: Pre‑culture thawed effector cells (if needed)
steps.instruction: If thawing effector cells, plate them one day in advance in 200 µL R10 (for PBMCs) or 200 µL B0 with 50 U/mL IL‑2 (for iPSC‑NK cells). Culture overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. The next day, spin at 300 g for 5 min to remove excess media before proceeding with the assay.

steps.title: Wash cells in permeabilization buffer
steps.instruction: Wash cells in 150 µL permeabilization buffer (10 % Permeabilization Buffer, cat. 00‑8333‑56, eBioscience, diluted in distilled H₂O).
